task: A composition-based redesign of the animal hierarchy with explicit interfaces, no multiple inheritance, and parity tests.

criteria.text: No multiple inheritance anywhere, and no FlyingSwimmingAnimal-style combined base class.
Capabilities are separate components with explicit interfaces (typing.Protocol or abc.ABC): at least flying (wingspan), swimming (max_depth) and diving (dive_speed).
An animal is composed of an identity (name, weight) plus any set of capabilities; a Duck is built from flying + swimming without a combined base class, and a diving bird adds diving.
Behavioural parity: fly(), swim() and dive() return exactly the original strings ('{name} flies with {wingspan}m wingspan', '{name} swims to {max_depth}m', '{name} dives at {dive_speed}m/s').
Tests prove parity against the original strings, including a duck and a diving bird.
